claims.text: At stage-1 the product list's sign-in button calls Navigator.of(context).push with a MaterialPageRoute building LoginScreen, and after sign-in LoginScreen calls pushReplacement with a MaterialPageRoute building CreateOrderScreen.

A route pushed as a MaterialPageRoute with no RouteSettings name gives the screen no path: the Navigator only reports a route name to the engine when settings.name is non-null, so the browser's address bar keeps the address the app started with.
claims.source_hint: Flutter SDK widgets/navigator.dart: route name reported to the engine only when settings.name != null; Flutter docs: Navigation and routing

claims.text: A GoRoute pairs a path with a builder (context, state) that creates the screen; a child route sits in its parent's routes list and its path is joined to the parent's (orders/new under / is /orders/new); router.dart, like the go_router docs, writes child paths without a leading /.
claims.source_hint: go_router 16.3.0 doc/configuration.md (GoRoute, Child routes), CHANGELOG 14.2.9 (leading / optional); router.dart:43-59 @ stage-2; probe on stage-2 archive: matches [/, /orders/new]

claims.text: MaterialApp.router takes a routerConfig; DonHangApp passes ref.watch(routerProvider), and routerProvider is a Provider<GoRouter> that builds one GoRouter from _routes (it also holds a redirect, not described here).
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang @ stage-2: DonHang.App/lib/main.dart:28-29, router.dart:13-36; Flutter API MaterialApp.router

claims.text: context.go(location) is shorthand for GoRouter.of(context).go(location): it finds the GoRouter above the widget through BuildContext.
claims.source_hint: go_router 16.3.0 doc/navigation.md ('shorthand for calling GoRouter.of(context).go'); lib/src/misc/extensions.dart:26-27

claims.text: Going to a location replaces the screens shown with the screens configured for that location; for /orders/new that is ProductListScreen from / with CreateOrderScreen on top of it.
claims.source_hint: go_router 16.3.0 doc/navigation.md (Go directly to a destination), doc/configuration.md (Child routes); probe on stage-2 archive: signed-in cart tap -> matches [/, /orders/new]

claims.text: A GoRoute's builder runs only when its route is part of the matched location: at / only ProductListScreen is built; ProductDetailScreen and CreateOrderScreen do not exist until their location is shown.
claims.source_hint: go_router docs: GoRoute.builder; generator check: flutter test probe on stage-2 archive (at start list=1 detail=0 create=0 login=0)

claims.text: On the web, go_router reports each location it shows to the browser after the frame that shows it; the back arrow pops the top screen and / is reported. So in DonHang.App, where every move goes through a location, the address bar names the screen shown.
claims.source_hint: probe on stage-2 archive: SystemChannels.navigation routeInformationUpdated /products/3 after tap, / after BackButton; Flutter Router reports in a post-frame callback

claims.text: In product_list_screen.dart at stage-2 the cart button calls context.go('/orders/new'), the sign-in button context.go('/login'), and the product tile's tap handler context.go('/products/${product.id}') on line 31; no Navigator.push remains in DonHang.App/lib.
